create_racecar_zed_env: create a RacecarZEDGymEnv instance with discrete actions and GUI rendering enabled
reset_racecar_zed_env: reset the RacecarZEDGymEnv simulation to place the ball and racecar in new random positions
step_racecar_zed_env: step the RacecarZEDGymEnv with a forward and steering action to move the racecar
get_extended_observation: get the camera image observation from the racecar perspective as a numpy array
render_racecar_zed_env: render the RacecarZEDGymEnv scene as an RGB array for visualization
